Hi John

The swipe action settings apply only to swipes performed from the message list, and can be set to none.

Navigate to settings > general settings > interactions > swipe actions.

If you enquiring about disabling the left and right navigation swipes between open emails, there is no configuration available for that.

A similar question was asked on github linked here.

If this is the feature your suggesting, the best place to share the idea is on Mozilla connect where community members can vote for it. TB take these ideas into consideration when planning their road map.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/idb-p/ideas/label-name/thunderbird%20android
